text_elements.text: To improve the Li-ion battery life, never perform quick charge heavily.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Use the method of nighttime normal charge or timer-controlled charge.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Never place EV battery in an area exposed to direct sunlight or under high temperature conditions.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: PRECAUTIONS FOR STORAGE OF THE LI-ION BATTERY
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Apply insulating tape to the service plug and high voltage harness connector, and protect the terminals so that nothing contacts them.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Store in a well-ventilated location that is not exposed to direct sunlight.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Never set directly on the floor.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Lay an anti-static rubber sheet underneath the battery.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Cover with an anti-static cover sheet.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Put a caution display stating "CAUTION! HIGH VOLTAGE" on the insulated cover sheet.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Put identification display showing the name of person in charge on the insulated cover sheet.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Never allow water to contact the battery.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Prevent other objects from falling onto the battery.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: CONSULT performs the following functions via CAN communication with Li-ion battery controller (LBC).
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: *: The following diagnosis information is cleared when the VCM memory is erased.
text_elements.label: footnote

text_elements.text: Part number of LBC can be checked.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Regarding items of DTC, refer to EVB-45, "DTC Index".
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Touch 'ERASE'. (DTC in LBC will be erased.)
text_elements.label: list_item
